34: def _empty_store() -> dict:

38: def _migrate_store(store: dict) -> bool:
39:     """Apply additive schema changes while retaining all existing records."""
40:     changed = False
41:     if "next_user_id" not in store:
42:         store["next_user_id"] = 1

54: def init_db() -> None:
55:     """Initialize the flat-file schema and migrate older stores in place."""
56:     path = Path(DATABASE)
57:     with _storage_lock:
58:         path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
59:         if not path.exists():
60:             _write_store(_empty_store())
61:             return

67: def _read_store() -> dict:
68:     path = Path(DATABASE)

70:         return _empty_store()

72:         return json.load(data_file)

75: def _write_store(store: dict) -> None:
76:     path = Path(DATABASE)
77:     temporary_path = path.with_name(f".{path.name}.tmp")

88:         if any(user["username"] == username for user in store["users"]):

92:             "username": username,

144:                 return task.copy()
145:     return None

150: ) -> dict | None:

152:         store = _read_store()
153:         for task in store["tasks"]:
154:             if task["id"] != task_id or task.get("owner_id") != owner_id:
155:                 continue
156:             if title is not None:
157:                 task["title"] = title
158:             if status is not None:
159:                 task["status"] = status

165: def _base64url_encode(value: bytes) -> str:
166:     return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(value).rstrip(b"=").decode("ascii")
167: 
168: 
169: def _base64url_decode(value: str) -> bytes:
170:     return base64.urlsafe_b64decode(value + "=" * (-len(value) % 4))

173: def create_token(user_id: int) -> str:
174:     now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
175:     header = {"alg": "HS256", "typ": "JWT"}
176:     payload = {
177:         "sub": user_id,
178:         "iat": int(now.timestamp()),
179:         "exp": int((now + timedelta(seconds=app.config["JWT_EXPIRATION_SECONDS"])).timestamp()),
180:     }
181:     encoded_header = _base64url_encode(json.dumps(header, separators=(",", ":")).encode())
182:     encoded_payload = _base64url_encode(json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":")).encode())
183:     signing_input = f"{encoded_header}.{encoded_payload}"
184:     signature = hmac.new(
185:         app.config["JWT_SECRET_KEY"].encode(), signing_input.encode(), hashlib.sha256
186:     ).digest()
187:     return f"{signing_input}.{_base64url_encode(signature)}"
188: 
189: 
190: def decode_token(token: str) -> int | None:
191:     try:
192:         encoded_header, encoded_payload, encoded_signature = token.split(".")
193:         header = json.loads(_base64url_decode(encoded_header))
194:         payload = json.loads(_base64url_decode(encoded_payload))
195:         supplied_signature = _base64url_decode(encoded_signature)
196:     except (ValueError, TypeError, json.JSONDecodeError, UnicodeDecodeError, binascii.Error):
197:         return None
198: 
199:     if header != {"alg": "HS256", "typ": "JWT"}:
200:         return None
201:     signing_input = f"{encoded_header}.{encoded_payload}"
202:     expected_signature = hmac.new(
203:         app.config["JWT_SECRET_KEY"].encode(), signing_input.encode(), hashlib.sha256
204:     ).digest()
205:     if not hmac.compare_digest(supplied_signature, expected_signature):
206:         return None
207: 
208:     user_id = payload.get("sub")
209:     expires_at = payload.get("exp")
210:     if (
211:         not isinstance(user_id, int)
212:         or isinstance(user_id, bool)
213:         or not isinstance(expires_at, int)
214:         or expires_at <= int(time.time())
215:     ):
216:         return None
217:     return user_id
218:

220: def jwt_required(view):
221:     @wraps(view)
222:     def authenticated_view(*args, **kwargs):
223:         authorization = request.headers.get("Authorization", "")
224:         scheme, separator, token = authorization.partition(" ")
225:         if separator != " " or scheme.lower() != "bearer" or not token:
226:             return jsonify({"error": "authentication required"}), 401
227:         user_id = decode_token(token)
228:         user = get_user(user_id) if user_id is not None else None
229:         if user is None:
230:             return jsonify({"error": "invalid or expired token"}), 401
231:         g.current_user = user
232:         return view(*args, **kwargs)
233: 
234:     return authenticated_view

238:     data = request.get_json(silent=True)

        "title": "Legacy task",
        "status": "pending",
